entries.text:
The CSV file '/app/data.csv' has been successfully converted to Parquet format as '/app/data.parquet'. 

The conversion process included:
1. Installing required Python packages (pandas and pyarrow) in a virtual environment
2. Reading the CSV file with headers: name, age, city
3. Converting the data to Parquet format
4. Verifying the conversion by reading back the Parquet file

The original CSV file contained 5 rows of data with 3 columns. The resulting Parquet file is 2276 bytes in size and contains the same data structure. You can now use '/app/data.parquet' for your data processing needs.
